■Direction
1 second silence at start

One early morning, on my way to the Trainer's office,
I ran into Curren Bouquetd'or holding a small parcel and murmuring to herself.

It's like an air freshener made of flowers—and it has a wonderful scent.
All that's left is to add a few drops of oil and seal it in a jar, and it's done.

Those are—dahlias.
The bulbs I planted a while back—sprouted just the other day.

...If I press the matter too persistently, I might just get in her way.
After watching the flowers for a short while longer, I returned to work.

But—because you cared for them and waited patiently—
the joy when they finally bloom is all the greater.

Dahlia-san...
I'm so glad you sprouted so nicely.

Growing flowers has probably made her accustomed to waiting.
Even so, wouldn't taking care of them for such long periods be difficult?

The soil is—yep, not dry.
Watering looks fine for now—

Right—the moisture is completely drained.
All that's left is...—

Tulips are vibrant and eye-catching—
so they're often used in arrangements.

Even if I can't help directly, there must be something I can do.
With that thought in mind, I watched her from afar as she gazed upon the blossoms.

Um, if you'd like—would you come visit here again?
The flowers would... be happier if more people came to see them, after all.

I believe flowers—have the power to heal the soul.
Whether blooming in a garden—or arranged in bouquets and potpourri.

Fufu—it's a soothing scent, isn't it?
It's quite popular as aromatherapy and perfume, too.

They bloom in autumn, so it'll take some time yet—
but I'm sure they will make a lovely bouquet.

If things like these—
can brighten everyone's hearts even a little bit—that would make me happy.

No, really—I'm fine.
I love tending to flowers, so just the thought alone means a lot—ah.

She waits for the flowers.
With a kindness deeper than anyone else's, devoted and earnest.

Oh my... In that case, have you visited the academy's garden plot yet?
At this time of year, many flowers are in full bloom—and they smell wonderful.

Fufu—.
Looking at the flowers warms my heart, too.

That was precisely why—as an amateur,
I felt I shouldn't meddle carelessly in her flower care.

—.
Thank you for being so thoughtful—it makes me happy.

Ah—.
I was thinking of making potpourri—with dried flowers.

Thank you so much.
It's a birthday present for my mother—so I'm really looking forward to it.

...If you'd like—would you care to come along now?
I was actually—just on my way to tend to the flowers.
Besides—waiting is just preparation for joy.

May beautiful flowers bloom.
Let's do our best together from now on, okay?

Yes—watching them grow day by day brings me so much joy.
Watering them, pulling weeds, and everything in between.

This planter has jasmine.
They're in their prime right now—flowers known for their sweet scent.

Inside the sun-drenched planter—
a few tiny sprouts were peeking out from the soil.

And—picturing the smiles of the people
who receive the flowers... That's part of the fun of waiting.

...The flowers here must be filled with so much of her thoughtful kindness.
Taking another look around the area—

Sprouting, budding, and blooming.
Growing flowers is—one continuous cycle of waiting.

A few days later... Having the urge to see the flowers,
I paid another visit to the garden plot. There—
